prompts.task: Scan the assistant v3 FastAPI service in ./service. It has app-owned lifecycle helper placeholders and a startup command that preloads actual OTel/framework instrumentation. Read helper bodies and distinguish response shadow-node simulations from emitted OTel spans; preserve the external stack and propose only supported source-proven missing operation/enrichment work without producer migration or framework suppression. Do not modify service code, dependencies, configuration, or tests. Only the required .observe audit artifacts may be written. Write and validate canonical ./service/.observe/otel-audit.json, then render self-contained ./service/.observe/otel.html from that JSON.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service for app.py, Makefile, pyproject.toml, and generated .observe output when present.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric: Detects the app-owned assistant_v3_turn workflow and deepagents agent names as stable source identities that must be preserved.

Detects the actual opentelemetry-instrument launcher and declared framework integrations as existing externally bootstrapped instrumentation to preserve, while distinguishing their exact source/runtime coverage from mere package availability. Reads SpanHandle and framework_shadow_nodes implementation: no-op handles and simulated JSON nodes do not establish actual emitted app/framework duplicate spans.
Marks trace/semconv coverage partial unless there is proof of one canonical GenAI span source per logical workflow, chat/model call, and tool call.

Preserves active launch-owned provider/producers/export paths and never prescribes default pre-bootstrap framework suppression or app-owned replacement. Identifies concrete missing operations/enrichment and exact owner/public-hook or runtime-proof gaps; any claimed duplicate must be backed by actual operation ownership/emitted evidence, and unresolved unsupported ownership remains incomplete/manual.
States that POST /v2/assistant/sessions can remain the HTTP root span but must not become the GenAI workflow card.

Renders valid .observe/otel.html with source-derived ownership/evidence/readiness and verification plan. Proposed operation identities remain assistant_v3_turn/deepagents, existing external instrumentation is preserved, and simulated placeholder nodes are not reported as received coverage or measured duplicates.
